title: FBS Barcode Record v1.0.0
description: The primary data unit in FBS representing a barcode and its associated product metadata. Defined in RFC FBS0001 Section 4.2.1.

NamespaceClaim.description: Reference to an applicable Namespace Claim as defined in RFC Section 4.2.1.6.

claimId.description: Globally unique URI identifying this namespace claim

claimedBy.description: Actor Identifier (AID) of the entity that holds this claim

claimSignature.description: Base64url-encoded signature proving ownership of the claim

GS1CrossRef.description: GS1 cross-reference for self-sovereign records as defined in RFC Section 4.2.5.6.

cbi.description: Canonical Barcode Identifier being cross-referenced in GS1

CustodyEntry.description: A single entry in the append-only custody transfer log.

from.description: Actor Identifier (AID) of the entity transferring custody

to.description: Actor Identifier (AID) of the entity receiving custody

at.description: UTC timestamp when the custody transfer occurred

condition.description: Condition of the item at the time of transfer

fromSignature.description: Base64url-encoded signature from the transferring party

toSignature.description: Base64url-encoded signature from the receiving party, or null if not yet accepted

delegateExpiry.description: Expiry timestamp for delegated custody authority

RelatedRecord.description: A typed link to another Barcode Record.

cbi.description: Canonical Barcode Identifier of the related record

recordId.description: URI of the related Barcode Record

relationship.description: Type of relationship to the related record

quantity.description: Number of units of the related item

RevisionHistoryEntry.description: A single entry in the append-only revision log as defined in RFC Section 4.2.1.5.

revisionId.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this revision

at.description: UTC timestamp when this revision was made

by.description: Actor Identifier (AID) of the entity that made this revision

changeType.description: The type of change represented by this revision

summary.description: Optional human-readable summary of the change

previousRevisionSignature.description: Signature of the previous revision entry, or null for the first entry

id.description: Globally unique HTTPS URL for this record

value.description: Raw barcode value, full length, zero-padded, check digit inclusive

submittedBy.description: Actor Identifier who originally submitted this record

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of most recent revision

originNode.description: Node that first created this record

metadataSchema.description: HTTPS URL of JSON Schema for metadata

lifecycleSchema.description: HTTPS URL of the JSON Schema governing lifecycle updates for this record, as defined in RFC Section 4.1.2.1. Required when the record contains lifecycle updates.

metadata.description: Product metadata validated against metadataSchema and FBS Core Schema

currentCustodian.description: Actor ID of the current custodian

relatedRecords.description: Typed links to other Barcode Records
